why.T3-003: The largest sustained strand reports members' own placing, cleanup and defence labour. Item-is-a-bag: achievement celebration (T3-009), credit and thanks (T3-043), victory claims (T3-154), accounts of survival (T3-073), and reflection on unity (T3-157) also have distinct support.

why.T3-023: Members enact the sub's Winnipeg identity through hockey discussion, cross-sport roles and explicit assertions that this is now a Winnipeg Jets sub. These are replies inside the changed subreddit rather than independent member hoaxes.
A member proposes an April Fools sidebar image, moderators confirm their arrangement, and the member anticipates it. The joke concerns the sub's appearance for the day.

why.T3-139: Repeated petitions ask Lebanese placers to stop damaging Mexican and Austrian hearts. Item-is-a-bag: making an Austrian truce (T3-149), forming a broader alliance (T3-150), exchanging protection or help (T3-151), and enforcing existing terms (T3-195) each carry separate concepts.

why.T3-023: Members enact the AutoMod/Machine King takeover through assimilation, mock resistance and binary posts. Resistance remains in character; the single request to contain shitposting does not establish sustained objection.
The moderators announce parody data-collection rules and members play inside the resulting praise-and-ban regime. This is a staged change to the subreddit, not a member's independent fake.
